name: Prusament PLA ColorMix bundle
description: Prusament PLA ColorMix bundle 7x1 kg. Nominal colors from the OpenPrintTag database. Includes a reference calibration (CORE One INDX, 0.1 mm layers, matte white core); calibrate your own printer for the most accurate colors (ColorMax Engine > Calibrate). Gold and Silver Glitter are accents: clear PLA with glitter, layered for sparkle.

calibrations.id: Reference: CORE One INDX 0.1mm, matte white core
calibrations.printer: Prusa CORE One INDX 8T HF0.4 nozzle
calibrations.notes: Shipped with ColorMax: measured on a Prusa CORE One INDX (0.4 mm HF nozzle), 0.1 mm layers, colored walls 0.9 mm deep over a white core printed from a separate opaque matte White, dual walls 0.45 mm; flatbed scanner. 240 swatches (45 held out). A calibration of your own printer and spools is more accurate.
